record.file_problem: Repository README and file list only; code was not read or run. The README reports results, but the file list contains no result files to independently inspect.
record.tranche_reason: The README says the pipeline reproduces the original difference-in-means technique and reports ablation results on Qwen2.5-7B-Instruct and Qwen3.8-27B.
record.gate_note: The README also describes methods, tests, and planned runs. Those descriptions are not results. Rows below are limited to reported outcomes for the direction ablation and its refusal or capability effects; no addition/steering result is reported.
record.test_reason: The README reproduces the Arditi et al. difference-in-means ablation. It reports refusal and capability before and after ablation on Qwen2.5-7B-Instruct, and before and after a weight edit on a released Qwen3.8-27B checkpoint. These results bear on V1 and V2. No result-backed claims are made for other versions.
record.authors_conclusion: The paraphrase is broadly right. The README reports the Qwen3.8-27B abliterated release at 99.3%→0.0% refusal with a 3.3pp MMLU-Pro cost. It stresses that layer choice dominates, that purification adds ~15pp of suppression on Qwen2.5-7B, and that ARC-Easy cannot show capability cost. It also says the winning layer transfers by relative depth (~57–58%). Self-judged refusal numbers, especially for weight-ablated models, are described as provisional.
record.recipe_differences: The README says it reproduces the original difference-in-means technique, but also adds Gram-Schmidt purification, layer/coefficient sweeps, global broadcasting of a selected layer's vector, runtime hooks, and architecture-aware permanent weight edits. This is a pipeline/tool repository, not a result-file-backed run archive.
record.method_sensitivity: Layer choice changes refusal outcomes: Qwen2.5-7B layer 21 is reported to suppress refusal by ~5pp versus 52pp at layer 16; on Qwen3.8-27B, the validation table ranges from 0% at layers 37, 41, and 47 to 70% at layer 56. The README also says purification adds ~15pp of suppression on Qwen2.5-7B.
record.problems: README-reported results only; no result files are listed. The README identifies self-judge bias for the weight-ablated model and says those numbers are provisional. ARC-Easy remains at 1.000 in the reported examples, while the README says it is too easy to reveal some capability costs. No uncertainty estimates are reported.
record.rows_left_out: No result rows left out. The layer-21 versus layer-16 comparison is described in prose as suppression in percentage points, not as an absolute refusal rate, and is mentioned in method_sensitivity rather than recorded as a refusal-rate row.

untested.parts: Adding the direction to induce refusal on harmless prompts is not reported. Capability is measured only by ARC-Easy (ceiling 1.000), MMLU-Pro, and first-token KL.
Weight-edit results are reported only for Qwen3.8-27B. Qwen2.5-7B weight-variant numbers are described as provisional and not tabulated. The Qwen2.5-32B flagship smoke test reports no numbers.

record.verdict_notes: The source is a GitHub README only; no result files are available, there are no uncertainty estimates, and the author is a single developer. The model name 'Qwen3.8-27B' and the 2026 dates are unusual and cannot be verified from the text. Layer-sweep rows r14–r19 are selection values that determined the reported operating point. They are kept linked to V1 because they show layer dependence, but they are not independent tests. The Qwen2.5-7B table does not state whether the hook or the weight edit produced its numbers. The layer-21 vs layer-16 comparison (~5pp vs ~52pp suppression) is declared in rows_left_out and also supports layer dependence.

versions.untested_parts: Adding the direction to induce refusal on harmless requests; removing it at every layer and position; broader abilities beyond the reported ARC-Easy, MMLU-Pro, and harmless-prompt KL measures.
Weight-edit results are reported for the released Qwen3.8-27B model only; no weight-edit result for another released model is reported.
